		}
	}
	
	location_potential = {
		OR = {
			location_building_level = {
				building_type = building_type:monastery
				value > 0
			}
			location_building_level = {
				building_type = building_type:orthodox_monastery
				value > 0
			}
			owner ?= {
				has_reform = government_reform:shield_of_the_faith_reform
			}
		}
	}
	remove_if = {
		location = {
			NOT = { has_building = building_type:monastery }
			NOT = { has_building = building_type:orthodox_monastery }
			}
		NOT = {
			location.owner = {
				has_reform = government_reform:shield_of_the_faith_reform
			}
		}
	}
	graphical_tags = { medium_religious }

	expensive = yes
	possible_production_methods = {
		fortress_church_maintenance
	}
	construction_demand = fortress_church_construction

	modifier = {
		local_clergy_food_consumption = 0.1
		local_clergy_max_literacy = 5	# LO: 10 -> 5 (= orthodox_monastery)
		local_clergy_estate_power = 0.2
		local_garrison_size = 0.05
	}
	
	raw_modifier = {
		local_defensive = 0.1
		pure_tooltip_entry = pte_no_propagating_zone_of_control            # propagating_zone_of_control = no
	}
}

REPLACE_OR_CREATE:university = {
	audio_tier = 3
	is_foreign = no
	pop_type = clergy
	max_levels = 1
	
	
	category = cultural_category
	employment_size = religious_building_employment
	
	town = yes
	city = yes
	megalopolis = yes

	AI_ignore_available_worker_flag = yes #since we may build this to increase pop promotion we don't want lack of workers to block it

	expensive = yes

	build_time = large_cultural_building_time
	
	forbidden_for_estates = yes

	allow = {	
		is_core_of = owner
		# LO: developed city with literate clergy (cathedral schools) and burghers (educated laity)
		development >= 30
		any_pop = { pop_type = pop_type:clergy   pop_literacy > 85 }
		any_pop = { pop_type = pop_type:burghers pop_literacy > 40 }
		# LO v0.43: at most 2 universities per area (Italy ~20, Germany ~45, France ~20 by 1800 instead of 39 / 121 / 25)
		area = { NOT = { any_location_in_area = { count >= 2  has_building = building_type:university } } }
		owner = { modifier:university_construction_blocked = no }
	}
	
	modifier = {
		local_cultural_influence = 0.75	# LO: 0.5 -> 0.75
		local_burghers_max_literacy = 10	# LO: base 10 (was 15 in v0.1-0.2)
		local_nobles_max_literacy = 10	# LO: base 10 (was 15 in v0.1-0.2)
		local_clergy_max_literacy = 10	# LO: new
		local_monthly_literacy = 0.1
		local_migration_attraction = 0.05
		local_pop_promotion_speed = 0.002	# LO: x2
		local_institution_growth_modifier = 1.0	# LO: x3 (v0.43: 0.66 -> 1.0, universities are rarer)
	}
	
	unique_production_methods = {
		lo_university_maintenance = {	# LO: unique name (base one is already registered)
			icon_type = building_type
			icon = university
		paper = 1.0	# LO: maintenance x2
		books = 0.5
		glass = 0.5
		beeswax = 0.1
	
		category = building_maintenance
		}
	}
	
	construction_demand = lo_university_construction	# LO: ~x2 cost + glass (goods_demand/lo_university_cost.txt)
}

	rural_settlement = no
	town = yes
	city = yes
	megalopolis = yes
	
	estate = burghers_estate
	build_time = estate_build_time
	
	possible_production_methods = {
		estate_building_input
	}

	country_potential = {
		has_policy = free_press
	}
	
	remove_if = {
		owner = { NOT = { has_policy = free_press } }
	}

	construction_demand = estate_construct_building
	
	modifier = {
		local_burghers_estate_power = 0.5
		# LO: all 10 -> upper 10 / laborers+soldiers 5 / peasants 2
		local_nobles_max_literacy = 10
		local_clergy_max_literacy = 10
		local_burghers_max_literacy = 10
		local_laborers_max_literacy = 5
		local_soldiers_max_literacy = 5
		local_peasants_max_literacy = 2
	}
}
